title: Category-Defining Companies and the Series A Gap
primary_theme: Late-seed support for category-defining companies approaching Series A
founder_lessons: Start talking to a Series A specialist months before the round so the fundraising process can be excellent.
Aim to create or define a category rather than become the seventh similar company in a crowded field.
Use specialized investors for the next gigantic hurdle rather than expecting one investor to solve every problem forever.
Understand that even experienced entrepreneurs may need help raising Series A because they have done it only a few times.
notable_quotes: Nine months ahead of series A is sort of nirvana
Generally, there are three things. This is super simplistic but I'm looking for companies where they're creating a new category.
I'm a mentor at a bunch of different accelerators, but the one that I'm most active with is the Stanford StartX Accelerator.
